characters.name: [Head Guard of Rulid] Zink
characters.title: Head Guard of Rulid
characters.desc: The head guard of Rulid Village in Underworld. He inherited this Calling from his father, and claims to be the most powerful swordsman in the village. According to village law, he is able to enter the Zakkaria Swordsmanship Tournament in four years time, and he takes objection to Eugeo attempting to join the Zakkaria Garrison before he does. In order to prove that he is the more skilled swordsman, he challenges Eugeo to a duel.

characters.name: [Apprentice Guard] Egome
characters.title: Apprentice Guard
characters.desc: An apprentice garrison guard in Zakkaria in Underworld. As a noble, he believes that he is free to do anything he wishes as long as it is not forbidden by law, as seen when he lets a greater swampfly loose at the city's west gate in order to make a horse run rampant. When he meets Kirito and Eugeo at the Swordsmanship Tournament he looks down on them, calling them "jobless and homeless." Before his match with Kirito, he bribes the sentinel in charge of distribution in order to get a better sword.

characters.name: [Cactus-Haired Swordsman] Kibaou
characters.title: Cactus-Haired Swordsman
characters.desc: A SAO player. He plays a cactus-haired swordsman who uses a one-handed sword. At the meeting before the 1st floor boss raid, he angrily blames the beta testers for the deaths of 2,000 players in a single month. He later forms the Aincrad Liberation Squad with the aim of distributing resources as fairly as possible.

characters.name: [Black Swordsman] Kirito
characters.title: Black Swordsman
characters.desc: A SAO player. Clad all in black, he uses a one-handed sword and no shield. Even among the members of the front-line Assault Team, he's highly respected for his combat ability, and despite being a solo player has mapped more unexplored Labyrinth areas than many entire guilds have. The guild he was once aligned with was completely wiped out, and because of this traumatic experience he avoids working together with others.

characters.name: [All-Enveloping Darkness] Kirito
characters.title: All-Enveloping Darkness
characters.desc: An "unregistered unit" who found himself in Underworld. He is imprisoned in the Central Cathedral for violating the Taboo Index by harming the life of another, but escapes. He is rescued by Cardinal, and learns how this world came into existence. In order to defeat Administrator, he learns the Perfect Weapon Control art and recovers his sword—"The Black One"—from the armory.

characters.title: Blooming Rose
characters.desc: A swordsman originally from Rulid Village in Underworld. He is imprisoned in the Central Cathedral for breaking the laws of the Taboo Index, but escapes. He learns the Perfect Weapon Control art from Cardinal, and recovers his sword—the "Blue Rose Sword"—from the armory. In order to rescue his childhood friend Alice, who has lost her memories and became an Integrity Knight, he heads for the top floor of the Central Cathedral to face Administrator.

characters.name: [Sleeping Knights] Siune
characters.title: Sleeping Knights
characters.desc: An ALO player. She plays an Undine, and is a member of the Sleeping Knights guild. She always maintains a calm composure, and as her team's only mage, is responsible for supporting and healing the other members. Together with Yuuki and the rest of her guild, she has traveled through countless VRMMO worlds in order to find the most exciting one so that they can leave their mark on it and create unforgettable memories for themselves.

characters.name: [Wind Fairy] Leafa
characters.title: Wind Fairy
characters.desc: An ALO player. She plays a Sylph magic-swordsman. Known as the "Speedaholic," she is obsessed with flying, and thanks to her many years of kendo training is recognized as one of the five strongest Sylphs. Her initial foray into virtual worlds was an attempt to get closer to her brother, who was trapped inside SAO. She offered to travel to the World Tree together with Kirito, without knowing that he was in fact her brother.

characters.name: [Moonlit Black Cats] Sachi
characters.title: Moonlit Black Cats
characters.desc: A SAO player. She plays a spear-user, and is the only female member of the Moonlit Black Cats guild, which is made up of her fellow computer club members from high school. She switched to using a Shieldblade at the recommendation of her leader, but is finding it difficult, as her timid personality makes her ill-suited to close-range combat. Gripped by a fear of death, she was unable to sleep at night, but she gains temporary relief from this as a result of her interactions with Kirito.

characters.name: [Four Whirling Blades] Dakira
characters.title: Four Whirling Blades
characters.desc: A low-ranking Integrity Knight of the Axiom Church in Underworld. She is a member of the Four Whirling Blades, who were personally trained by Fanatio. The four members, who are all identically equipped, attack using what is effectively a group combo skill. She has a crush on her leader, Fanatio, but is happy just to be near her, and keeps her emotions hidden deep down inside.

characters.name: [Osmanthus Knight] Alice
characters.title: Osmanthus Knight
characters.desc: Alice Synthesis Thirty, the 30th Integrity Knight of the Axiom Church in Underworld. Clad in golden armor, she appears at the Swordcraft Academy to take away Kirito and Eugeo after they violate the Taboo Index. Although now dressed differently, her face and golden hair are unmistakably those of Eugeo's childhood friend Alice Zuberg, but she acts as if she is a different person.

characters.title: Merciless Magic Swordsman
characters.desc: An ALO player. Her speed and skill with a sword make her one of the 5 strongest Sylphs. When attacked by Salamanders in the Legrue Corridor, at Kirito's behest she takes on the role of healer, though she is not used to doing so. Facing a flawless defense and endless onslaught of attacks, she prepares herself for death, but is then deeply touched by Kirito's determination to go on living.

characters.name: [1st Floor Boss Raid Leader] Diavel
characters.title: 1st Floor Boss Raid Leader
characters.desc: An SAO player. He uses a one-handed sword, and half-jokingly refers to himself as a "knight." He organizes the meeting before the 1st floor boss raid, and with his eloquent manner and shrewd leadership ability is able to put together a raid group made up of 44 of the top players in the game. Although his leadership qualities are genuine, he hides the fact that he was a former beta tester.

characters.name: [Knights of the Blood] Kuradeel
characters.title: Knights of the Blood
characters.desc: A SAO player. He is a member of the Knights of the Blood guild. He was assigned as Asuna's personal guard, and displays an unusual attachment to her. He oversteps the mark on several occasions, such as by secretly staking out her apartment. He despises Kirito, who grows closer to Asuna by the day, and challenges him to a duel but loses. When dismissed from his position as personal guard, his hatred grows even stronger.

characters.name: [Lance Squad Captain] Kagemune
characters.title: Lance Squad Captain
characters.desc: An ALO player. He is captain of the Salamanders' Lance Squad. He is a magic-warrior, and as well as his lance also makes use of everything from fire-elemental attack magic to the Searching skill. He is renowned for his Sylph-hunting ability; by combining a well-timed ambush with an attack formation using heavy armor and relentless charging lance attacks, he forces even Leafa's veteran player-packed party to retreat.

characters.name: [Fuurinkazan] Klein
characters.title: Fuurinkazan
characters.desc: A SAO player. He uses a katana, and is easily recognizable by his spiky red hair and gaudy bandanas. He's the leader of Fuurinkazan, a guild he formed together with his friends, who he helped level up to the point that they were all included in the Assault Team. He's been friends with Kirito since before the official release of SAO, and is a strong supporter of his. He worries about Kirito, and sometimes tries to caution him.

characters.name: [High-Norkian Style Swordsman] Volo
characters.title: High-Norkian Style Swordsman
characters.desc: An Elite Disciple at Norlangarth Imperial Swordcraft Academy in Underworld. His position as First-Seat Elite Disciple is unchallenged. He bears the family name of a line of traditional instructors in the Sword Arts of the Imperial Knight Order, which carries with it a secret "family rule," and is a skilled user of the official High-Norkian Style. His swings are so powerful that, using a wooden sword, he shatters the log used for training. He demands that Kirito duel with him with real swords as punishment for splashing mud on his uniform.

characters.name: [Swordcraft Academy First-Seat] Raios
characters.title: Swordcraft Academy First-Seat
characters.desc: An Elite Disciple at Norlangarth Imperial Swordcraft Academy in Underworld. He is the eldest child of a third-rank noble family, and the First-Seat Elite Disciple in Kirito and Eugeo's year. He holds commoners and low-ranking nobles in great contempt, and takes every opportunity he can to show it. He's arrogant and spiteful, but his enormous conceit seems to be a source of strength, and his skills with a sword are a cut above those of the other students from noble backgrounds.

characters.name: [Swordcraft Academy Second-Seat] Humbert
characters.title: Swordcraft Academy Second-Seat
characters.desc: An Elite Disciple at Norlangarth Imperial Swordcraft Academy in Underworld. A high-ranking noble from a fourth-rank noble family, he's the Second-Seat Elite Disciple in Kirito and Eugeo's year, and is Raios's friend turned sidekick. He's an unpleasant character, but has been specially trained in the High-Norkian Style since a young age, and his skill with a sword is no joke. When his duel with Eugeo—who he despises as a commoner—ends in a draw, he takes his anger out on his own page, Frenica.

characters.name: [Sleeping Knights] Yuuki
characters.title: Sleeping Knights
characters.desc: An ALO player. She plays a young Imp girl who leads the Sleeping Knights guild. An extremely fast one-handed sword user, she has fought over 60 street duels and not yet lost a single one. When she defeated Kirito, he said, "If she'd been a SAO player, it would have been her who received the Dual Blades skill." Her extraordinary power has earned her the alias "The Absolute Sword."

characters.name: [Engraved in Stone] Yuuki
characters.title: Engraved in Stone
characters.desc: An ALO player. Known as "The Absolute Sword," she is an extraordinary swordswoman who created an astonishing 11-hit Original Sword Skill. As a last memory for the members of her soon-to-be-disbanded guild, the Sleeping Knights, she wants to defeat a Floor Boss and have the names of all the members engraved on the Monument of Swordsmen. She takes a liking to Asuna after crossing swords with her in a street duel, and asks her for assistance.

characters.title: Fiery Determination
characters.desc: A Novice Trainee at Norlangarth Imperial Swordcraft Academy in Underworld. She comes from a low-ranking noble family, and is Eugeo's page. She was brought up believing that nobles must do their utmost to ensure the peace and happiness of all the people. As a result, even though he's a high-ranking noble, she refuses to accept Humbert's despicable acts towards her friend Frenica, and goes to confront him together with Ronie.

After consulting with Kirito about her friend Frenica's situation, she learns the importance of being guided by one’s own sense of justice rather than just following the law.

characters.name: [Warrior Merchant] Agil
characters.title: Warrior Merchant
characters.desc: A SAO player. He's a merchant who owns a shop in the city of Algade on the 50th floor of Aincrad, and is friends with Kirito. He's also a skilled axe user, and will sometimes abandon his shop to go and fight on the front line. He appears greedy and profit-driven, but in fact invests the majority of the earnings from his business into helping mid-level players to level up.

characters.name: [Salamander Leader] Eugene
characters.title: Salamander Leader
characters.desc: An ALO player. He's the general of the Salamanders, and the younger brother of their current lord. In terms of combat ability alone he's said to be the strongest among all the Salamanders, and thus in all of ALO. He's also the owner of Demonic Sword Gram, a legendary weapon of which only one exists on the server. He launches an attack on the conference between the Sylph and Undine lords, leading to a heated battle between him and Kirito.

characters.name: [Baltio Style Swordsman] Golgorosso
characters.title: Baltio Style Swordsman
characters.desc: An Elite Disciple at Norlangarth Imperial Swordcraft Academy in Underworld. His position as Third-Seat Elite Disciple is unchallenged. He boasts a body like tempered steel, and uses a formidable single-hit-knockout sword style known as Baltio Style. He selects Eugeo, who like him is a commoner and former guard, as his page. As well as sword techniques, he teaches him the importance of mental fortitude to a swordsman.

characters.name: [Titan's Hand Leader] Rosalia
characters.title: Titan's Hand Leader
characters.desc: A SAO player. She is the leader of the orange guild Titan's Hand, but her cursor is green, rather than orange like those of "criminal" players. She uses this to help her infiltrate parties, and then waits for the right opportunity to have her fellow guild members attack and loot them. She scoffs at the concepts of law and justice, and does not even balk at committing murder.

characters.name: [Sylph Lord] Sakuya
characters.title: Sylph Lord
characters.desc: An ALO player. She's a strikingly beautiful individual, and is the elected leader of the Sylph race, as well as an expert odachi user. Although being busy with her duties as Lord means that her stats are by no means high, she has made it to the final of many dueling tournaments. She has a strong sense of justice, and is very popular with her people—she was elected as Lord with 80% of the vote. In order to lead a combined attack on the World Tree, she forms an alliance with the Cait Sith.

characters.name: [Combat Demon] Asuna
characters.title: Combat Demon
characters.desc: A SAO player. She plays a rapier user, and commands her comrades from the front line as sub-leader of the Knights of the Blood, the most powerful guild in the game. She is renowned as a top-class swordswoman, and as well as being one of the few females in Aincrad, is also extremely beautiful, making her even more of an oddity. Determined to escape from this virtual world, she puts everything she has into trying to beat the game.

characters.name: [Fairy Blacksmith] Lisbeth
characters.title: Fairy Blacksmith
characters.desc: An ALO player. She played a blacksmith in SAO, and again chose to become a Leprechaun blacksmith in ALO. She runs Lisbeth Armory on the main street of Yggdrasil City, and is responsible for maintaining the equipment of Kirito and the others. She is best friends with Asuna. Although her race makes her ill-suited to combat, her curiosity as a mace user made her duel with the Absolute Sword.

characters.name: [Primary Trainees’ Dorm Supervisor] Azurika
characters.title: Primary Trainees’ Dorm Supervisor
characters.desc: The supervisor of the Novice Trainee's dorm at Norlangarth Imperial Swordcraft Academy in Underworld. She was once the First Sword of the North Empire, and was awarded the title of first-rank noble after ranking highly in the Four Empire Unification Tournament. Her casting speed far exceeds that of the academy's Sacred Arts teacher, and she goes against the Taboo Index by healing Eugeo's eye. She acts as if she understands the truth about Underworld to some extent.

characters.name: [Fierce Flash] Asuna
characters.title: Fierce Flash
characters.desc: A SAO player. She's a rapier user, and her speed and accuracy with a sword have earned her the alias "The Flash." She stands out from the other players in terms of both looks and sword skills, and despite her sweet appearance is sub-leader of the Knights of the Blood, the most powerful guild in the game. When not honing her combat skills, she uses her spare time to fully complete the Cooking skill.

characters.name: [The Girl Who Forgot Her Name] Operator
characters.title: The Girl Who Forgot Her Name
characters.desc: The "Operator" who is responsible for the floating platform that goes up past the 50th floor of the Central Cathedral in Underworld. Like Integrity Knights, her Calling has been frozen, and she has continued to operate the platform, using the Sacred Arts, for 107 long years. This near-eternity of solitude has caused her to forget even her own name. She tells Eugeo that if released from her Calling she would like to fly freely through the sky.

characters.name: [Primary Trainee] Frenica
characters.title: Primary Trainee
characters.desc: A Novice Trainee at Norlangarth Imperial Swordcraft Academy in Underworld. According to Tiese, her roommate at the dorm, she is "a great girl—hardworking and diligent, and very humble, despite her skill with a sword." She is selected as page by Humbert, who continually gives her inappropriate orders, causing her great distress. Unable to stand by and let this continue, Tiese and Ronie ask Eugeo and Kirito for help.

characters.name: [Cait Sith Lord] Alicia
characters.title: Cait Sith Lord
characters.desc: An ALO player. She plays the beautiful Lord of the Cait Sith, a race with cat-like ears and tails who are adept at using the Taming skill to control monsters and animals. She's extremely popular with her people, and has held power for even longer than Sakuya has. Her ace-in-the-hole is a combat force known as the Cait Sith Dragoons, who have never even been captured in a screenshot.

characters.name: [The Rat - Information Dealer] Argo
characters.title: The Rat - Information Dealer
characters.desc: A SAO player. She's Aincrad's number one information dealer, and is commonly known as "Argo the Rat." She'll sell any and all information that she can, and people say that if you spend just 5 minutes chatting with her she'll manage to wheedle 100 Cors' worth of information out of you. She used her experience as a beta tester to publish the "Strategy Guide by Area" on the first floor, which has helped out many players.

characters.name: [Young Idol] Silica
characters.title: Young Idol
characters.desc: An SAO player. She's a renowned dagger user among mid-level players, and is also one of the few Beast Tamers in the game. She is extremely attached to the little dragon Pina, who gave her warmth and comfort when she was trapped in the closed world of SAO at the age of just 12. Known as "Silica the Dragon Tamer," she has a lot of fans, and is constantly receiving requests to join different parties and guilds.

characters.name: [Diligent Sacred Arts Student] Selka
characters.title: Diligent Sacred Arts Student
characters.desc: A resident of Rulid Village in Underworld. An apprentice sister, she lives at the village church where she is studying the Sacred Arts, and also acts as caregiver to the orphans who live there. She hates being compared to her sister Alice, who was said to be the first genius student that the village produced. She secretly has a crush on Eugeo, who still holds feelings for Alice, and this causes her some angst.

characters.name: [Sage of the Great Library] Cardinal
characters.title: Sage of the Great Library
characters.desc: A subprocess of the Cardinal System, the autonomous program that controls Underworld. Her duty is to correct errors made by the main process, Administrator, and she has spent 200 years in the Great Library of the Central Cathedral, observing and ruminating. She rescues Kirito and Eugeo when they are being pursued by an Integrity Knight, and reveals the secrets of Underworld to Kirito.

characters.name: [Apprentice Integrity Knight] Linel
characters.title: Apprentice Integrity Knight
characters.desc: Linel Synthesis Twenty-Eight, an apprentice Integrity Knight of the Axiom Church in Underworld. She was part of a group of children who were used as guinea pigs for the "Resurrection" Sacred Art experiments, in which their Calling was to repeatedly kill each other. She and Fizel were the last survivors, and a special exception was made in order to allow them to become Integrity Knights. However, the two of them are fed up with being forced to undertake the daily training that comes with being an apprentice Integrity Knight.

characters.name: [Apprentice Integrity Knight] Fizel
characters.title: Apprentice Integrity Knight
characters.desc: Fizel Synthesis Twenty-Nine, an apprentice Integrity Knight of the Axiom Church in Underworld. She was part of a group of children who were used as guinea pigs for the "Resurrection" Sacred Art experiments, in which their Calling was to repeatedly kill each other. She and Linel were the last survivors, and a special exception was made in order to allow them to become Integrity Knights. However, the two of them are fed up with being forced to undertake the daily training that comes with being an apprentice Integrity Knight.

characters.name: [Noble Aspiration] Sortiliena
characters.title: Noble Aspiration
characters.desc: An Elite Disciple at Norlangarth Imperial Swordcraft Academy in Underworld. She has been the Second-Seat Elite Disciple since enrollment. Although equally matched with Volo—the First-Seat—in terms of skill, she is not confident in her ability to block his powerful skills, and has never beaten him in combat. She comes from a family that was banned from using the official High-Norkian style and instead practices a constantly changing practical combat style known as "Serlut Style." She chooses Kirito, who uses a similar sword style to her own, as her page.

featured.title: Wish Hard Enough and Surely… Scout

characters.name: [Rose Garden Knight] Eldrie
characters.title: Rose Garden Knight
characters.desc: Eldrie Synthesis Thirty-One, the 31st Integrity Knight of the Axiom Church in Underworld. He uses a divine object called the Frostscale Whip. On the orders of Alice, his mentor, he waits for Kirito and Eugeo in the Rose Garden when they escape from the underground prison. Although he tells them that he was summoned here from the heavens just a month ago, he was in fact the winner of the Four Empire Unification Tournament that same year, and when Eugeo points this out it throws him into a state of confusion.

characters.name: [Upon a Wishing Star] Asuna
characters.title: Upon a Wishing Star
characters.desc: Asuna descends into the Underworld using the super account, "Creation Goddess Stacia". Wishing to save the world that Kirito tried to protect and meet her lover, Asuna decides to do a full drive from the Soul Translator #5. She swears to herself that for him, she will do any crime and take any punishment. Whatever it takes.

characters.name: [Knight of the Abyss] Eydis
characters.title: Knight of the Abyss
characters.desc: Eydis Synthesis Ten, the 10th Integrity Knight of the Axiom Church in Underworld. Possessing the sacred treasure, "Dark Slash Sword" which was born from the depths of a lake where no light reaches, she stands out even amongst the Integrity Knights. She has an honest personality towards others, making her stick out from the other Integrity Knights who have more of a serious character. She treats Alice like a younger sister, much to the chagrin of Alice herself.

characters.desc: Alice Synthesis Thirty, the 30th Integrity Knight of the Axiom Church in Underworld. Knowing that the forces from the dark territory desire the so called "Priestess of Light", decides to act as a decoy in order to put distance between the enemies and Human Empire. That night, the "Goddess of Creation Stacia" confirms the relationship between Asuna and Kirito while Alice suggests a deal to Asuna visiting the tent where he is getting treated.

characters.name: [Resting Goddess] Asuna
characters.title: Resting Goddess
characters.desc: Asuna dives into the Underworld using the super account, "Creation Goddess Stacia". On the night that Asuna and the Human Empire army promised to fight together, Alice waits in front of Kirito's tent to offer exchanging information relating to Kirito. In that deal, Asuna as well as Ronie and Sortiliena will join in the fight. The girls then reminisce over their indomitable love of Kirito since their days in SAO.

characters.name: [Staring Lovingly] Kirito
characters.title: Staring Lovingly
characters.desc: Long ago, there was a young boy imprisoned in the floating castle for 2 years who carried countless angst on his own shoulders. He experienced untold amounts of greetings and goodbyes. Like a collar that wouldn't come off. Despite this, Kirito had a reason for overcoming the many hurdles that stood in his way in this world. The time of spending days with the love of his life were beginning to come to shape for Kirito.

characters.name: [Waiting For You in the Skies] Eydis
characters.title: Waiting For You in the Skies
characters.desc: Wherever Alice is, that's where Eydis would be. Now, she is nowhere to be found. As the assault on the Human Empire draws closer with every waking moment, Eydis has no time to reminiscence over the olden days. It's the day that Eydis predicted long ago; the day when the world that Alice loved needs her the most. Even today as she stares into the sky, Eydis continues to wait for her little sisters return.

characters.name: [Embraced in Sunbeams] Alice
characters.title: Embraced in Sunbeams
characters.desc: Only two heretics bore witness to the death of the ruler of this world. A couple of months after, Alice was able to enjoy tranquil days with the heretic Kirito for a time. Even with no memories of her own nor the acceptance of the hometown she loves, Alice embraces the gentle warmth she bears inside of her. If only this peace could continue on for just even one more second. Dreaming from a lofty northern peak, Alice continues to pray for this.

characters.title: Smiling Lovingly
characters.desc: Treading through the elite course, Asuna stood up to the depths of despair which was being imprisoned in SAO. Asking herself why she reached out for this game in the first place. Ever since the time when only regret filled memories plagued her, Asuna discovered the true meaning of the world that was tucked away. The time of spending days with the love of her life were beginning to come to shape for Asuna.

characters.title: Puffing in the Waves
characters.desc: Packed with their new swimsuits, a large lifebuoy, and all preparations done, Lisbeth and the others went to the beach. "Let's jump in!" They exclaimed as they left their luggage in one spot, and jumped into the ocean. Playing volleyball and splashing around in the ocean, Lisbeth continued playing around until she got tired. Riding on the lifebuoy in the end, Lisbeth gazes up at the blue sky as the waves cradle her, satisfied with the day she just had.

characters.name: [Charming Heat] Alice
characters.title: Charming Heat
characters.desc: Nervously, Alice dips her toes into the clear waters of the bath. Up until this point she always made an excuse to not go, but today Eydis managed to drag her into the Great Bath. Though it is just among girls, Alice feels embarrassed being exposed without her armor, and felt Eydis's gaze that seemed to contain some expectations. With her face blushing for reasons other than the temperatures of the bath, Alice hopes that no one notices.

characters.name: [Overflowing Affection] Eydis
characters.title: Overflowing Affection
characters.desc: Today was the day Eydis finally got her bath with Alice. Eydis would ask her about it every time they met, but Alice would always say no. Today, however, Eydis was finally able to convince her to give it a shot. And as Eydis sat on the ledge that lined the inside of the tub, carelessly tracing her feet around in the soothing water, she eventually looked up at Alice, who was standing next to her. Suddenly a wave of emotions, both of joy and sadness, overcame her. But having finally gotten what she'd always wanted, she decided to lock those complicated feelings away and simply enjoy the moment.

characters.name: [Angel of Death] Subtilizer
characters.title: Angel of Death
characters.desc: The thief. The seeker. The taker. Only the essence of souls interest him. He only emotions he understands are the fear and despair one feels just before death. He wonders, how will the boy with the black hair's fear taste when I bring him within inches of his life? He feels a great thirst spring up inside of him. "Your feelings, your memories, your heart, your soul--I will devour every last drop."

featured.title: Angel of Death Scout - Subtilizer Pick-Up

characters.name: [The World I Should Love] Administrator
characters.title: The World I Should Love
characters.desc: Leader of the Human Empire and High Pontifex of the Axiom Church. In a desire to stagnate the world, she created and adopted the Taboo Index into the Human Empire, which listed all laws and rules that govern the land. For the Elite Noblemen who were given overwhelming authority, she allowed them to live a lazy yet tyrannical existence. However, the lone Irregular Unit with his sharpened sword will be at her throat soon enough to end this absurdity, once and for all.

featured.title: The Great Resistance Scout - Administrator, Cardinal Pick-Up

characters.name: [Sharp Marksman] Sinon
characters.title: Sharp Marksman
characters.desc: On ALO, Sinon picked the Cait Sith—a weapon known for its marksmanship abilities. Taking on a quest for a legendary weapon with Kirito and the others, she displayed her amazing marksmanship skills by hitting Excalibur—which was 200m up in the air—with her arrow. Then, without hesitation in the eyes of Asuna and the others, she whispers to Kirito. "I hope you think of me whenever you unsheathe your sword." says Sinon with a wink and smile on her face.

characters.name: [The Eternal Ice Swordsman] Eugeo
characters.title: The Eternal Ice Swordsman
characters.desc: In the End Mountains to the north resides the divine weapon, the Blue Rose Sword, born out of the eternal ice and a blue rose. Having long thought of being the stuff of legends, the sword released Eugeo from his Calling as a carver and set him off on a journey to rescue Alice. The sword's presence continued to support Eugeo on his journey. Like Kirito, it is his companion.

featured.title: Swordsman of Eternal Ice Scout - Eugeo Pick-Up

characters.name: [The Sword Shining in the Darkness] Eydis
characters.title: The Sword Shining in the Darkness
characters.desc: With her memories unlocked, the Dark Slash Sword spread darkness all around her. Because this darkness couldn't be controlled, she abstained from using it on the battlefield to avoid attacking her own allies. But when doing reconnaissance or fighting alone against many, she envelopes herself in darkness and demonstrates that effect to her heart's content. The war is not just on the front lines. Doing everything that she can in her role, Eydis pledges her body for the great war.

characters.name: [Trick or Party] Yuuki
characters.title: Trick or Party
characters.desc: Decorated with jack-o'-lanterns and candy in an assortment of colors, for one day only, the town's tavern was rented out to hold a Halloween party. The guild sponsoring this party was the "Sleeping Knights". Asuna and the others, who received an invitation, opened the doors of the tavern, where Yuuki appeared dressed in a cute dress with a cake decorated for this special day. "There you are! We've been waiting for you!" Yuuki exclaims with a smile as she welcomed them in.

featured.title: Trick or Party?! Scout - Yuuki Pick-Up

characters.name: [Star Lighting Up the Night Sky] Kirito
characters.title: Star Lighting Up the Night Sky
characters.desc: Trying to buy time until Asuna and Alice arrives at the World's End Altar, Kirito took on the black-cloaked nihilistic Gabriel in a heated battle. With each one of his attacks being absorbed, Kirito is overwhelmed by the sheer power before him and it seems as those his consciousness might be dragged back into the darkness. But in that moment, a faint warmth enveloped his left hand and a familiar voice beckoned him back from the abyss.

characters.name: [The Other Hero] Eugeo
characters.title: The Other Hero
characters.desc: In order to return the lost memories of the Integrity Knight Alice, Eugeo climbed up to the Cloudtop Garden on the 80th floor of Central Cathedral to reunite with her. Leaning on the Osmanthus tree, Eugeo closed his eyes and in that moment, memories of his childhood came flooding back. Although he is at a loss for words when aiming his sword at Alice, betting on a sliver of hope he had gotten from the Cardinal, together with Kirito, they faced off against Alice.

characters.name: [Walking in the Water] Asuna
characters.title: Walking in the Water
characters.desc: Wow! The ocean is so beautiful... Whenever Asuna would go to the beach, she would toss away her sandals and walk the rest of the way. Feeling the heat from the sand underneath her feet, the wide open expanse of the ocean in front of her were beyond her expectations. "Swimming with the fishes has been my dream ever since I was little!" Asuna exclaimed. Unable to contain her excitement, Asuna jumps into the emerald green sea to be with the tropical fish.

characters.name: [Unwavering Knight] Alice
characters.title: Unwavering Knight
characters.desc: Alice's body and soul grew tired as she fought off one red soldier after another. Her conscious begins wearing off as she continued fighting off enemy swordsmen who didn't value their own lives—for a moment, it seemed that she herself would succumb to fleeing the battle lines. But she stood her grounds—strengthened by her resolve to protect those who are special to her in this world. Chanting a spell and concentrating all of her consciousness towards her fingers, Alice releases a flame spear. "Discharge"!

characters.name: [Serene Shooting Star] Asuna
characters.title: Serene Shooting Star
characters.desc: The girl who was imprisoned in the death game that was SAO—Asuna. "I want to be me until the very last moment... No matter what, I don't want to lose in this game... No, this world." With that thinking, she fought her way through the labyrinth where she met Kirito. "That was a little bit overkill back there." Kirito comments. Afterwards, Asuna forms a party with Kirito for the first time and conquered the boss of the first floor. By fighting with Kirito, it was the first time that Asuna discovered her goals in this world...and who she wants to follow.

characters.name: [Budding Friendship] Leafa
characters.title: Budding Friendship
characters.desc: Leafa descended down into the Underworld as "Mother Earth Terraria". She had no knowledge of the people and places of the Underworld, but what she saw and the conversations she had would tell her all she needs to know. Only her own sense of justice decides where she aims her sword. A source of hope in a world stained with blood.

featured.title: Friendship Budding from the Earth Scout
Friendship Budding from the Earth Scout - Leafa Pick-Up

characters.name: [A New Beginning] Kirito
characters.title: A New Beginning
characters.desc: Post-war life continues for Kirito down in the Underworld. Even though his position as the Human Unification Council's Swordsman Delegate has made it difficult for him to venture out freely, he still manages to slip out from the Cathedral from time to time to watch over the town and it's people.

characters.name: [Dusk Approaching] Rain
characters.title: Dusk Approaching
characters.desc: An original character who appeared in the game, Sword Art Online: Lost Song. Rain is a blacksmith fairy (Leprechaun) who fought alongside Kirito and his party in ALO. She uses a two-sword style like Kirito, but if you ask her, she'd tell you it's actually a "multi-sword style". She's also one of the very few players in all of ALO who possess the rare OSS.

featured.title: As Twilight Approaches Scout - Rain Pick-Up

characters.name: [A Thousand Years With You] Asuna
characters.title: A Thousand Years With You
characters.desc: Asuna stayed behind in Underworld with Kirito. Having already maxed out her cooking skills in SAO, Asuna was interested in dishes from this world as well. Spending time in the kitchen, Asuna studied new cooking methods while getting valuable advice from the former cook of the High Pontifex, Hana. Something sure smells delicious...

characters.name: [Shot Through the Dark] Sinon
characters.title: Shot Through the Dark
characters.desc: Sinon was agitated as she encountered Subtilizer. Vivid memories of her experiences in BoB flashed in her head as her consciousness laid in limbo. Resisting these dark thoughts, Sinon uses her memories and imagination to transform her Solus bow into her Hecate II, her favorite. She bolts back into action and peers through the scope of her one companion. "I won't lose... Not with you by my side, Hecate!"

featured.title: Bullet Piercing the Darkness Scout - Sinon Pick-Up

characters.name: [Sprint Towards the Future] Ronie
characters.title: Sprint Towards the Future
characters.desc: Acknowledging her own inexperience pained her to the core. But she knew what she had to become. It was her destiny to become a full-fledged knight and to have her own special sword. These goals seemed high and distant...but despite the odds, she swears to herself to achieve these goals no matter the difficulties she may endure. One step at a time...

featured.title: A Future Breaking into a Run Scout
A Future Breaking into a Run Scout - Kirito Pick-Up
A Future Breaking into a Run Scout - Ronie Pick-Up

characters.name: [Radiant Scent] Yuuki
characters.title: Radiant Scent
characters.desc: A gentle breeze blew through the blue skies. Sunlight twinkled through the trees as a crystal clear voice crept in between. "Let's fly!" Without hesitation, she stretched out her hand towards the hand in front of her. She knew she was in safe hands, as the smile in front of her guided her.

featured.title: You Smell of Sunshine Scout - Yuuki Pick-Up

characters.name: [The Integrity Knight With the Black Sword] Kirito
characters.title: The Integrity Knight With the Black Sword
characters.desc: Limit Break Character Illustration - illust：abec

featured.title: A Future Breaking into a Run Scout
A Future Breaking into a Run Scout - Kirito Pick-Up
A Future Breaking into a Run Scout - Ronie Pick-Up

characters.name: [Underneath the Osmanthus] Eydis
characters.title: Underneath the Osmanthus
characters.desc: She took a deep breath of the fragrant flowers. With a slight breeze from the wind, the orange flowers quickly scattered and decorated her blonde hair. A slight smile formed on her face from this tranquil moment. Though she cannot stay for long, she enjoys her break before another mission beckons her away.

featured.title: That Day, Beneath the Osmanthus Scout
That Day, Beneath the Osmanthus Scout - Eydis Pick-Up

characters.name: [Eternal Beauty] Administrator
characters.title: Eternal Beauty
characters.desc: Eternal beauty...how boring. Listening to the sounds of water drops falling, she finally can relax and wash all these thoughts away. Cracks of light illuminated her skin while her wet hair accentuated her undeniable beauty. She stretched out her elegant legs from the snow white bathtub as the fragrance of flowers wrapped itself around her aura. Through the thin screen of steam, her allure entices.

characters.name: [Singing On] Yuna
characters.title: Singing On
characters.desc: He could faintly hear a familiar singing voice. Even among the throngs of people that filled streets of the town, he could still hear it. Looking closely at the figure sitting on the rail overhead, she was just as he imagined. Her mischievous eyes met his. "Oops. Looks like you found me; let's keep it a secret between you and me."

featured.title: Ordinal Scale 4th Anniversary Scout - Yuna Pick-Up

characters.name: [Cross Slash] Kirito
characters.title: Cross Slash
characters.desc: Kirito and Asuna discovered the boss room on the 74th floor. Just as quickly as they opened the intimidating door to check on the boss, the two withdraw with all their speed. On the other hand, the Aincrad Liberation Force, who had attacked the boss were blocking the entrance, leaving them in a dire situation. Asuna then rushes to the rescue, followed by Kirito. Resolving that they will be wiped out at this rate, Kirito grips on to his Elucidator on his right hand and the Dark Repulser on the left, confronting the boss with an extra skill that no one has ever seen before.

featured.title: Love Is a Labyrinth Scout - Kirito Pick-Up
Love Is a Labyrinth Scout - Asuna Pick-Up

characters.name: [Love Is a Labyrinth] Asuna
characters.title: Love Is a Labyrinth
characters.desc: Of course forming a party together was for strategic purposes, but Asuna would be lying if she said it wasn't fun being in a party where it's just the two of them. Nestled in the basket were handmade sandwiches that Asuna had prepared. Seeing him stuff his face with the bread is a sight that she could never forget. "With a reaction like that, I should cook even more for him!"

featured.title: Love Is a Labyrinth Scout - Kirito Pick-Up
Love Is a Labyrinth Scout - Asuna Pick-Up

characters.name: [Strength Goals] Tiese
characters.title: Strength Goals
characters.desc: Tiese become an Integrity Knight apprentice. Recalling the lessons that Eugeo had given her, she spends her days practicing her sword swing. A void had opened within her heart from the loss of that special person, and she feared that sooner or later memories of that person may become a distant memory. Though she has these thoughts, perhaps it's inexperience that make her feel this way? Focusing her body and soul, she continues to work towards becoming a powerful swordsman.

featured.title: Aiming for That Strength Scout - Tiese Pick-Up

characters.name: [The Flower and Swordsman Awakens] Leafa
characters.title: The Flower and Swordsman Awakens
characters.desc: She was sound asleep, but the bright lights cascading down overhead woke her up. Stretching out her back, the flowers around her rustled in the wind as if smiling at her. This spot was high up from the ground with branches blocking the view. Like a small room just for her, this place was one of her favorite spots.

featured.title: Awakening of Flowers and Swordsman Scout
Awakening of Flowers and Swordsman Scout - Leafa Pick-Up

characters.name: [Evening Escape] Alice
characters.title: Evening Escape
characters.desc: Alice wondered what was the point of having a banquet like this. The rude look on the people from the real world pierced her steel body, leaving a sense of unease sink into her. Everything around her felt fictitious and unreal. Perhaps the only thing in common between their two worlds was the soft moonlight.

featured.title: Slipping Out of the Soirée Scout
Slipping Out of the Soirée Scout - Alice Pick-Up

characters.name: [Hard Day's Work] Eydis
characters.title: Hard Day's Work
characters.desc: Eydis was completely focused on her training. Taking a deep breath, she stared up at the sky. The sun shone between the trees signaling that it was the afternoon already. As Eydis prepared to return back to her quarters, her hair had tussled into her view. Stopping in her tracks, she combed through her long hair and tied it back into a ponytail. "Appearances are also important". Walking again, her black hair elegantly swayed with every step she took.

featured.title: Sweat on a Sparkling Afternoon Scout
Sweat on a Sparkling Afternoon Scout - Eydis Pick-Up

characters.name: [Faraway Skies] Alice
characters.title: Faraway Skies
characters.desc: The sun shown bright in the dew of the flowers as a breeze danced playfully through her hair. Alice again found herself in unfamiliar surroundings. Yet it was still different than the real world. Tracing out the mountains in the distance, a sense of nostalgia overcame her. She gazed up at the sky and laughed. There was nothing to be afraid of, Alice is Alice wherever she may be.

featured.title: Unital Ring Special Scout - Alice Pick-Up

characters.name: [Time Between Us] Yuuki
characters.title: Time Between Us
characters.desc: Yuuki slowly closed her eyes as she laid down on the sofa, the sunlight enveloping her like a blanket. She was seconds from slumber when she heard gentle, deliberate footsteps coming from the kitchen. It was Asuna. The soft aroma of freshly steeped tea began to fill the room. With her finger twirling a lock of hair, Asuna playfully asked, "Still up?". Yuuki refused to respond. This peace, the calm in her heart, this feeling she was experiencing was rare for her. Just one moment longer, please.

featured.title: Time for Just You and Me Scout
Time for Just You and Me Scout - Yuuki Pick-Up

characters.name: [Captive Princess] Asuna
characters.title: Captive Princess
characters.desc: Asuna shifted her eyes away as if hiding from the light. Though she had an escape plan and kept her cool, her anxiety crept forward as time passed by. This turned into fear as she caught herself staring idly into the far off distance. Even though she vowed to carry these heavy feelings, they all slowly faded away with time. A heart of ice left in their wake.

featured.title: The Captive Queen Scout - Asuna Pick-Up

characters.name: [Soaring Over the Horizon] Leafa
characters.title: Soaring Over the Horizon
characters.desc: The coast was all clear. Leafa quickly slipped out of the forest while checking the perimeter around the log house where everyone had made their new base of operations. Although she was perplexed by the world that she suddenly found herself in, Leafa found solace around the company of her friends. It was the start of a whole new adventure for Leafa...And the thrill of it all resonated deep within her.

featured.title: Unital Ring Special Scout Vol. 2 - Sinon Pick-Up
Unital Ring Special Scout Vol. 2 - Leafa Pick-Up

characters.name: [Renaissance Diva] Seven
characters.title: Renaissance Diva
characters.desc: Seven is an original character who first made her appearance in "Sword Art Online: Lost Song". Hailing from Russia, she is a science prodigy. She plays as a pooka in ALO where she performs as a VR idol to accomplish her goals.

featured.title: Lost Song 6th Anniversary Scout - Seven Pick-Up

characters.name: [Wilderness Explorer] Sinon
characters.title: Wilderness Explorer
characters.desc: Sinon watched the dust sweep through the dry earth around her. It's a sight that she had seen countless times on GGO, but this time she found herself in uncharted territory. Observing her surroundings with a careful eye, she pondered her next course of action. Though she had her doubts regarding the equipment she had with her, it was better than nothing. Still, her beloved gun remained behind in storage, leaving Sinon feel lost without it. Casting away these feelings, Sinon runs off into the wastelands to assess her situation.

featured.title: Unital Ring Special Scout Vol. 2 - Sinon Pick-Up
Unital Ring Special Scout Vol. 2 - Leafa Pick-Up

characters.name: [Dual Fists] Iskahn
characters.title: Dual Fists
characters.desc: It felt as if the fire within him had smoldered. He asked himself, who and what was he fighting for? For him, there was only one reason - his friends. Though the pain from his crushed right eye resonated, his heart held steady. Not wanting to hold back his allies, Iskahn the boxer pressed forward against the red guards in front of him.

featured.title: Fists Fighting Together Scout - Iskahn Pick-Up

characters.name: [Blonde Treasure Hunter] Philia
characters.title: Blonde Treasure Hunter
characters.desc: An original character from the game, "Sword Art Online: Hollow Fragment", she is a SAO survivor. Earning the nickname "Treasure Hunter", she revels in seeking out treasure chests. She met Kirito in the Hollow Area in SAO.

featured.title: Hollow Fragment 7th Anniversary Scout - Philia Pick-Up

characters.name: [The Last Battle - Answer to Our Prayers] Kirito
characters.title: The Last Battle - Answer to Our Prayers
characters.desc: Everyone looked towards the night sky and prayed. For the safety over their loved ones and for peace to return once more to the world. Each one of these wishes become another tiny star that brightens up the night sky. Armed with dual blades containing the collected wishes of this world, Kirito presses forward to the last battle.

featured.title: Final Battle - Carrying Prayers Scout - Kirito Pick-Up

characters.name: [Life of Tomorrow] Alice
characters.title: Life of Tomorrow
characters.desc: Alice gently caught a soft ball of light that had dropped from the skies. Within that light, the baby dragons, Amayori and Takigur gazed upon Alice in their newborn innocence. Their warmth radiated hope from deep within her.

characters.name: [New Era] Kirito
characters.title: New Era
characters.desc: It's not easy being the Swordsman Delegate. There are probably many out there who think the same. Even now, Kirito could feel the unshakable feeling of someone stabbing him in the back at any given moment. If there was ever the possibility to solve problems without drawing our swords it would be great, but that doesn't seem to be the case here. The faint sound of pebbles being lightly crushed into one another alert Kirito of an incoming presence. He draws his sword and turns to face it. "I don't know who you are...but if you have any business with me then it's best you show yourself. I'm always ready for a fight."

characters.name: [Together in This World] Asuna
characters.title: Together in This World
characters.desc: Asuna glanced at the sun drenched world around her as she was saddled on top of her horse. Her eyes met with those of the people surrounding her, as the winds carried with them the laughter from the crowds and the rustle of the trees. Whenever she sees the denizens of Underworld living like this, Asuna swears to herself to grow in order to protect the people of this world.

characters.name: [Whimsical Rhapsody] Administrator
characters.title: Whimsical Rhapsody
characters.desc: How much time had passed? The the red flickers of a light caught in the wind illuminated her Eminence's porcelain skin. She was smiling, but her eyes were not. She was bored. I traced her form with my gaze in what seemed like a moment of eternity. She didn't even bat an eye. Perhaps she will be lenient? I became lost in thought, and in that moment I sighed, completely forgetting myself in the moment.

characters.name: [Memories of the Abyss] Eydis
characters.title: Memories of the Abyss
characters.desc: As Eydis lifted up her sword above her head, darkness spread out in front of her. Deep in the darkness, a familiar voiced beckoned to her, calling her name. "Who is that...?" Whoever it is, she felt compelled to save them. Though she thought hard as to who this person could be, nobody sprang to mind. Regardless, she knew that she had to save them, whomever it may be. Even if it means cutting down whatever stands in her way.

featured.title: Memories of the Abyss Scout - Eydis Pick-Up

characters.name: [Brawny Knight] Entokia
characters.title: Brawny Knight
characters.desc: Entokia Synthesis Eighteen, the 18th Integrity Knight of the Axiom Church in Underworld. Entokia was not able to participate in the war between the two worlds due to being sent to the Southern Empire. His divine weapon, the Roaring Thunder Spear, is a spear with a massive rectangular blade attached to it. It is a weapon created from a legendary beast that lived in the Southern Empire. Abnormally heavy, it is a weapon that even high ranking knights have a hard time lifting. Because of it's sheer size, it's not a weapon that people can carry and walk around the Cathedral with.

characters.name: [Holding Hands With You] Asuna
characters.title: Holding Hands With You
characters.desc: A wave of embarrassment overcame Asuna as she donned her dress once more. Although nothing should have changed for neither of them, there was just something different about her. And there was something different about him. Just by looking at his face, it was obvious. The embarrassment quickly dissipated at this realization. Afterall, that's why they fell for each other.

featured.title: Holding Hands with You Scout - Asuna Pick-Up

characters.name: [Scattering the Flowers of Life] Leafa
characters.title: Scattering the Flowers of Life
characters.desc: Leafa couldn't move an inch as the disgusting tentacle touched her body. Even virtually, this was something she never wanted to actually experience. But she mustn't give up. Human or not, Leafa vows to crush the enemy in front of her!

featured.title: Scattering the Flowers of Life Scout
Scattering the Flowers of Life Scout - Leafa Pick-Up

characters.name: [Dark Green Spearman] Nergius
characters.title: Dark Green Spearman
characters.desc: Nergius Synthesis Sixteen, the 16th Integrity Knight of the Axiom Church in Underworld. Having been faithful to the Administrator, Nergius still harbors resentment against the Swordsman Delegate, Kirito of the Human Empire Unification Council. With his divine weapon, Budding Storm Spear in hand, today Nergius and his steady demeanor takes aim at the Swordsman Delegate once more.

characters.name: [Fulfilling Life] Dee Eye Ell
characters.title: Fulfilling Life
characters.desc: Dee Eye Ell, chancellor of the Dark Mages Guild. She is a being with extra-ordinary aspirations. In addition to eventually becoming the ruler of this world, she also has a peculiar view on life. She consumes the flesh of her allies in order to prolong her life, and the next target on her list happens to be the female swordsman from the other world. With her powers, D.I.L. will become unstoppable.

featured.title: Fill Me with Sweet Life Scout
Fill Me with Sweet Life Scout - D.I.L. Pick-Up

characters.name: [Floating in the Lake] Alice
characters.title: Floating in the Lake
characters.desc: Alice dived into the middle of the lake, where a beautiful scenery awaited her. Seeing fish swimming among the seaweeds, she could feel the divine prominence of her surroundings. Feeling immersed with this scenery, Alice continues to hold her breath as she stared into every crevice of the lake bottom.

featured.title: Summer with You Scout - Alice Pick-Up
Summer with You Scout - Eydis Pick-Up

characters.name: [Aquatic Nitwit] Leafa
characters.title: Aquatic Nitwit
characters.desc: Leafa's felt a jolt of nervousness as the lifebuoy wobbled uncontrollably. "Relax! It won't wobble if you do!" she could hear from her brother, but if it was that easy she wouldn't find herself in this predicament. "Hold me!" she exclaims as she grabbed onto her brother's arm.

featured.title: Summer with You Scout Vol. 2 - Leafa Pick-Up

characters.name: [Skies Illuminating in the Waters] Eydis
characters.title: Skies Illuminating in the Waters
characters.desc: Forged from the heat of Solus, the waters of the lake around Eydis cooled her glowing skin. Comforted by this, she breathed a sigh of relief. Dipping her body into these waters and not the usual bath, is good from time to time. Even better when she finds herself with Alice.

featured.title: Summer with You Scout - Alice Pick-Up
Summer with You Scout - Eydis Pick-Up

characters.name: [In the Midst of Sunlight] Sortiliena
characters.title: In the Midst of Sunlight
characters.desc: Today was the day that Sortiliena went to go visit the springs in the suburbs. Arriving at her destination, the chirping of birds and an assortment of colorful flowers awaited her. She wondered how long it's been since she was able to relax and forget her troubles like this. Clear skies, a beautiful scenery—and the person next to her, made her feel content with what lay ahead.

featured.title: Summer with You Scout Vol. 4 - Sortiliena Pick-Up

characters.name: [Caught in the Waves] Sinon
characters.title: Caught in the Waves
characters.desc: Passing through a massive tube of waves, Sinon's bullet could just about slice through the skies. Thinking of the trajectory the bullet should pass through in the condensation the bullet creates, Sinon felt flustered as she realized how much she was thinking about a bullet.

featured.title: Summer with You Scout Vol. 3 - Sinon Pick-Up

characters.name: [Memories of Bygone Days] Alice
characters.title: Memories of Bygone Days
characters.desc: Maintaining order and tranquility within the Human Empire. Alice never once questioned this heavy responsibility that was bestowed upon her from the Integrity Knights. But upon seeing the suffering that those around her were going through, she was conflicted weather to extend a helping hand. "If only I had chanted a couple of lines from the manual, maybe even that kid's life..."Before she could think any more, Alice stopped herself mid-thought. Dwelling too much on these sort of matters are beneath that of an Integrity Knight.

featured.title: Memories of Days Past Scout - Alice Pick-Up

characters.name: [The Glow in Your Hands] Administrator
characters.title: The Glow in Your Hands
characters.desc: Whether it be man, beast, tree, flower, or any sort of unsightly being from the Dark Territory, all too can become equally beautiful if they were transformed into gems. That’s all life is. There is one key difference between the luster of gems and the virality of living beings. Unlike life, gems can maintain it’s beauty for all eternity. If only everything in this world could become a gem...

featured.title: Memories of Days Past Scout Vol. 2
Memories of Days Past Scout Vol. 2 - Admi Pick-Up

characters.name: [For Your Ears Only] Renly
characters.title: For Your Ears Only
characters.desc: I never did ask her what kind of flowers she likes... was the thought that went through Renly's head as he finally arrived at the flower shop. He's never bought anything for a girl before, not to mention that this sort of custom doesn't even exist where he comes from. Aside from the four holy flowers, he knows absolutely nothing about flowers. "If only there was something else I could give...". Pacing back and forth in front of the flower shop, Renly finally thought of something, and with a determined look on his face, called out for the shopkeeper.

I Want to Tell You Scout - Renly Pick-Up

characters.name: [Seductive Fumes] Ronie
characters.title: Seductive Fumes
characters.desc: As I arrived at the Great Bath, I met someone I wasn't expecting. It turned out to be Fizel Synthesis Twenty-Nine. Measuring only up to my chest, seeing her small stature made me want to grapple on to her tight and never let go, but that of course wouldn't be appropriate given my status. She is, after all, an official Integrity Knight, and the better swordsman. Not to mention a world-class spy.

characters.name: [In the Line of Sight] Kirito
characters.title: In the Line of Sight
characters.desc: Telling her directly that it was odd seeing her here would have attracted the unwanted ire of the shop owner... Despite the risks, it was hard not to see that someone like her stick out even in the packed store. She wore a white and red uniform with hair stretching all the way down to her waist...and hazelnut eyes that seemed to be looking in my direction. Nervously, I averted my gaze.

Secret Battle of Wits Scout - Asuna Pick-Up

characters.name: [Morning on the Front] Asuna
characters.title: Morning on the Front
characters.desc: Slowly but surely, I could see the end to the floor. All I needed now was the hint to beat the boss which I could get from a quest. But surely that one player in black must already know that hint. That's why today I've decided to seek him out and wring the info out of him. But something tells me that he won't do so without a fight, that's for sure...

Secret Battle of Wits Scout - Asuna Pick-Up

characters.name: [Bath After Dusk] Tiese
characters.title: Bath After Dusk
characters.desc: It's the best place in the entire Cathedral. At least, that's what the older knights preached. One dip in these waters and all your worries of the day go melting away is what they said. The bathes at the academy were big, but even those were nothing compared to the gargantuan size of the Great Bath. I wonder if Shimosaki would be happy if I brought her along to swim? Then again...the heat might just make her dizzy. "Frost" is in her name after all.

characters.title: The Trio's Future
characters.desc: A family... Never in my wildest dreams did I ever imagine that this day would ever happen to me. The boxer from a foreign land opened my eyes to what a future could mean. With our child within me, I vox to create a future for us. Though I may no longer carry a sword, as long as I am together with him, everything will be fine.

Journey to the Future Scout Vol. 2 - Sheyta Pick-Up

characters.name: [The Guide to the Future] Iskahn
characters.title: The Guide to the Future
characters.desc: After the war had ended, the world around us quickly changed. My circumstances as well as those of everyone in the Dark Territory had changed dramatically compared to just a short while ago. No matter what obstacles await us from this point forward, my fists will be ready to deal with them. For this world, for my family, and the siblings I swear to protect, I will lead them to a brighter future.

featured.title: Journey to the Future Scout - Iskahn Pick-Up

characters.name: [The Voice Resonating Within My Heart] Eydis
characters.title: The Voice Resonating Within My Heart
characters.desc: A burning sensation resonated deep within my right-eye as my head was struck with a pain that felt as if my head would crack open at any moment. Desperately clinging on to what little consciousness I had left, I gripped onto my sword which seemed to slip through my finger from the cold sweat. Although the girl said it was dangerous, I can't just submit to this pain. If it's to protect those who are precious to me, I don't care if I lose my right-eye or both for that matter. So I beg of you, lend me your strength. The one deep in my memories...the one dear to me.

characters.title: Beta Tester
characters.desc: It was just like a flash of light. With every flick of her rapier, enemies toppled over where they stood. I stood and admired over the speed and accuracy of her attacks, but in the heat of battle I could tell that she was reaching her limits. Even though I knew she didn't want me to, I called out to her.

characters.name: [Aria of a Starless Night] Asuna
characters.title: Aria of a Starless Night
characters.desc: It's morning. Even as I awoke from my drowsiness,  I still found myself in the same game from the night before. It's not a dream, but a nightmare...no, this was worse than that; this was my new reality. But I can't just sit back and wait for death to take me. I will press forward with own will and fight on. And even if I fail...that is still a far better fate than not trying at all.

In the real world, never would I have dreamed that I would go shopping with a girl... So I swore to myself, that no matter what, we would survive to do just that in the real world.

characters.desc: Eydis in an outfit to celebrate our 2-year anniversary. Even if we were to say our goodbyes, you'll always have a place in my heart. I'll always be thinking of you!

characters.name: [The Premier Knight] Alice
characters.title: The Premier Knight
characters.desc: Alice in an outfit to celebrate our 2-year anniversary. As you were always there for us, we will continue to be there for you. Always and forever.

characters.name: [Protector of Bonds] Kirito
characters.title: Protector of Bonds
characters.desc: Kirito in an outfit to celebrate our 2-year anniversary. Thank you for your continued support. Your support is what keeps us going. Here's to more adventures to come.

characters.desc: Asuna in an outfit to celebrate our 2-year anniversary. Thank you for always being there for us! Here's to more stories together!

characters.name: [The Frozen Integrity Knight] Eugeo
characters.title: The Frozen Integrity Knight
characters.desc: Eugeo in an outfit to celebrate our 2-year anniversary. I'm happy to have you by my side. Thank you always.

characters.name: [The Silent Sniper] Sinon
characters.title: The Silent Sniper
characters.desc: Sinon in an outfit to celebrate our 2-year anniversary. It's been a long run, hasn't it? Can't wait for what else is coming!

characters.name: [Winged Sword Duel!] Eugeo
characters.title: Winged Sword Duel!
characters.desc: So in this game, the other player should try to immediately hit the shuttle with the wooden paddle before it hits the ground. This so called "shuttle" training is harder than it looks. Compared to sword training, this requires quick reflexes on top of muscle. The odds can change at a moments notice...So I'll go on the offensive to make sure that Kirito's face gets sprayed with ink!

featured.title: WELCOME TO 2022!! Scout Vol. 2 - Eugeo Pick-Up

characters.name: [An Air of Happiness] Eydis
characters.title: An Air of Happiness
characters.desc: Though it may look like bread on the outside, it stretches out so much as soon as you put it in your mouth. What a bizarre snack! This soup is also so good, I think I might just get addicted to it! By the way, I wonder what "zoni" means in the Sacred Tongue? I'll have to ask Kirito later.

characters.name: [Morning Sun of the New Year] Alice
characters.title: Morning Sun of the New Year
characters.desc: The morning sun rose over the snowfield and in that instant, the whole horizon seemingly disappeared, with nothing but endless white ahead. It's during these moments that I love the most. Though I may disappear like the snow around me, that's what makes it ever more special.

characters.name: [Traditional New Years Celebration!] Klein
characters.title: Traditional New Years Celebration!
characters.desc: I'm really happy to be able to welcome the new year with everyone! I hope this year will be both safe and fun...with no funny business! Then again, there's really only one person here that I need to worry about... Anyways, cheers!

featured.title: WELCOME TO 2022!! Scout Vol. 3 - Klein Pick-Up

characters.name: [Memories in the Snowy Skies] Administrator
characters.title: Memories in the Snowy Skies
characters.desc: My memories disappeared to make room for souls. Despite having no sentiments nor attachments, it's not the worse fate that could have befallen me. Whether those memories were precious or cruel, it didn't matter. Because the past will never change. And the same goes for the future: if everything was fixed in place, then nothing will ever change.

featured.title: Memories to the Snowy Sky Scout
Memories to the Snowy Sky Scout - Admi Pick-Up

characters.name: [Catchy Rhythm] Leafa
characters.title: Catchy Rhythm
characters.desc: Never in my wildest dreams did I think that I would be performing a live concert. But, contrary to my thoughts, singing is the one thing that brightens up my mood. Afterall, singing while flying isn't exactly an easy thing to do in the real world. Performing with magic could be fun...I just need to be sure not to make this into a habit.

featured.title: Cheerful Music!! Scout Vol. 2 - Leafa Pick-Up

characters.name: [Tailwinds of the Dream Girl] Yuriko Nanao
characters.title: Tailwinds of the Dream Girl
characters.desc: This is so COOL! I'm in a fantasy world... but in real time! These wings on my back also let me fly through the skies at will... Just like a wind warrior! If I hear anyone crying for help, I will answer the call wherever they may be. Sounds just like what a protagonist in a story would say, right?

characters.name: [Cheerful Music] Asuna
characters.title: Cheerful Music
characters.desc: It was a weird mix of feelings; embarrassing, yet elating. When you sing your heart out, your body gets electrified with excited. But the one caveat being that whenever I looked over at the seats, even for just a moment, embarrassment enveloped me and I just wanted to disappear right there and then. Afterall, it's rare for me to sing in front an audience, let along anybody for that matter.

characters.name: [Heartbeat Delight] Sinon
characters.title: Heartbeat Delight
characters.desc: I can't believe I'll be walking out in this garb... Not to mention that he'll be out there in the seats as well. What is he going to say about this after the show...? I'm going to be embarrassed up there so he'll probably poke fun at me regardless. So my only option is to just get up on that stage and enjoy it for what it's worth.

featured.title: Cheerful Music!! Scout Vol. 3 - Sinon Pick-Up

characters.name: [Wrapped in Sweet Scents] Eydis
characters.title: Wrapped in Sweet Scents
characters.desc: It's pretty odd to have a set date on when to return the favor for a gift. Though, admittedly, it is a bit exciting waiting for that day to come. Alrighty! Let's try and pick out a gift - I wonder what gift will make her day?

characters.name: [Sweet Dreams, For You] Alice
characters.title: Sweet Dreams, For You
characters.desc: Upon sniffing the sweet sweet scents coming from the snacks, I woke up. The snacks that I found around me shimmered like gemstones - just eating one of these is sure to fill my mouth with glee. Surely this all must be a dream...or perhaps its a gift from you-know-who... Just thinking of this makes me blush.

featured.title: A Sweet Rendezvous with You Scout Vol. 2
A Sweet Rendezvous with You Scout Vol. 2 - Alice Pick-Up

characters.name: [Fierce Integrity Knight] Deusolbert
characters.title: Fierce Integrity Knight
characters.desc: A sharp pain pierced through my left arm unabated. What could it be? Then again, in comparison to the brave soldiers who sacrifice their lives for the safety of the Human Empire, this is nothing. These are sacrifices that can't be overlooked. In the end when there is nothing left, I will be sure to use this sword as an arrow...anything, so long as it means to annihilate the enemy.

featured.title: Integrity Knight of Raging Flame Scout
Integrity Knight of Raging Flame Scout - Deusolbert Pick-Up

characters.name: [The Legendary Chosen One] Yuuki
characters.title: The Legendary Chosen One
characters.desc: I'm just a regular ol' adventurer, not one of those hero types. But that doesn't mean that I can just sit back and watch the Demon King destroy the world around me. That and I can't let him getting away with the last attack bonus in the world! If I'm the only one who can pick up the mantle of hero, then I will fight with all my might!

featured.title: GRAND QUEST FANTASY - The Guided Absolute Sword - Scout
GRAND QUEST FANTASY - The Guided Absolute Sword - Scout - Yuuki Pick-Up

characters.name: [The Arrogant Demon Lord] Kirito
characters.title: The Arrogant Demon Lord
characters.desc: Why do people fight? Over territory? Queens? Last attack bonuses? It's because these things have no owners... yet. If I were to control all of these, then the fighting will cease, and a true peace will descend upon this world.

featured.title: GRAND QUEST FANTASY III - The Demon King Descends - Scout
GRAND QUEST FANTASY III - The Demon King Descends - Scout - Kirito Pick-Up

characters.name: [Enchanted Fairy Princess] Asuna
characters.title: Enchanted Fairy Princess
characters.desc: This world is peaceful and beautiful, making every day more enjoyable than the last. But that all came to an abrupt end when the wicked Demon King snatched me away. Trapped and isolated, the only thing I could do was pray... Pray for a hero to appear and mend the Demon King. Because deep down, even beneath all his wickedness, there still some good left in him.

featured.title: GRAND QUEST FANTASY II - The Beautiful Princess - Scout
GRAND QUEST FANTASY II - The Beautiful Princess - Scout - Asuna Pick-Up

characters.name: [Moonlight Integrity Knight] Ronie
characters.title: Moonlight Integrity Knight
characters.desc: Regaining the Integrity Knight armor and the title of Thirty-Three is too much to bear for someone as inexperienced as me. But if it means being able to continue standing by Kirito's side, then I will bear whatever it takes. Because I can't follow him since he's already ahead.

characters.name: [The Great Absolute Sword] Yuuki
characters.title: The Great Absolute Sword
characters.desc: Yuuki in her 2.5-year anniversary outfit. "Thank you for always being there by my side. It's thanks to you that I've made it this far. Here's to more memories together."

characters.name: [Pitiful Beast Tamer] Silica
characters.title: Pitiful Beast Tamer
characters.desc: Silica's 2.5-Year Anniversary Outfit: "I can always hear your voice. It's thanks to it that we can continue to fight. So please continue to support me and Pina...and everyone!"

characters.name: [Resolute Master Macer] Lisbeth
characters.title: Resolute Master Macer
characters.desc: Lisbeth's 2.5-Year Anniversary Outfit: "Breeding isn't something you can do by yourself you know! We need people who can fight like you guys! And as long as you guys are around, I will continue to help you out."

characters.name: [The Time Swordsman Delegate] Kirito
characters.title: The Time Swordsman Delegate
characters.desc: Although I couldn't return back to the real world, there are people in this world who need me. So long as Asuna remains by my side, I can overcome whatever obstacles there are.

Bridge to a New Era Scout - Asuna Pick-Up

characters.name: [Daybreak Guardian Knight] Eydis
characters.title: Daybreak Guardian Knight
characters.desc: So this is where they've been secretly building their minions, huh? My personality's been twisted because I've been with these things for so long. Or, on the contrary, maybe it's because my personality IS twisted that these things are always with me. Either or, it's time to tear this place apart.

characters.name: [Summer Night Flowers] Leafa
characters.title: Summer Night Flowers
characters.desc: Look over there! There's so many fireworks! They're so beautiful... I bet if we were closer it would be even better... Hey... I have an idea! How about we do that? Just... the two of us.

Great Blossoms in the Summer Night Scout - Leafa Pick-Up

characters.name: [Cool Nightly Breezes] Sinon
characters.title: Cool Nightly Breezes
characters.desc: Have you ever thought about how weird the light is that fireflies give off? It's not too bright by any means, yet it just grabs your attention. That's why I'll always remember this night... Not that it has anything to do with you. I'm talking about fireflies, remember?

featured.title: Evening Cool in the Sound of Wind Scout
Evening Cool in the Sound of Wind Scout - Sinon Pick-Up

characters.name: [Fresh Dark Knight Recruit] Sylvie
characters.title: Fresh Dark Knight Recruit
characters.desc: Today was the first time I stopped seeing those dreams. In those dreams, my parents were gone, nowhere to be found. I was alone, yet no matter how hard I looked, there was no way to get them back. The only thing I have is this sword, this sword that took away my parents. This sword is my only family now.

featured.title: Rising Dark Knight Scout - Sylvie Pick-Up

characters.name: [Beach Water Fairy] Asuna
characters.title: Beach Water Fairy
characters.desc: You know, it's quite peaceful sitting down after a long day together. I wonder if it's because we were out in the sunlight this whole time? But no worries, as long as I can feel you here, that's the only thing that matters in right now.

Water Fairy of the Shoreline Scout - Asuna Pick-Up

characters.name: [Fairy World Magic User] Leafa
characters.title: Fairy World Magic User
characters.desc: Although I've never worn such an outfit before, but it's actually not so bad. Instead of fighting with swords, it's nice to support Kirito with my magic from time to time!

featured.title: Bonds in Another World Scout Vol. 2
Bonds in Another World Scout Vol. 2 - Leafa Pick-Up

characters.name: [Silver Wolf Martial Artist] Kirito
characters.title: Silver Wolf Martial Artist
characters.desc: When I don this outfit, I can already feel my fists get stronger. Using a martial arts skill with this is surely to release something powerful. Although there was someone out there with a similar voice to me who also wore this, I wonder what kind of person they were? Someday, I hope I can meet that person.

featured.title: Bonds in Another World Scout - Kirito Pick-Up

characters.name: [What I Want to Protect] Kirito
characters.title: What I Want to Protect
characters.desc: It might only cause her trouble to be around me. That's something I worry about from time to time, even being here on the fifth floor. But I've already made up my mind. I'll continue to protect her with my life until she's strong enough that she doesn't need me anymore.

characters.name: [Walk This Path Together] Asuna
characters.title: Walk This Path Together
characters.desc: It still scares me to cross swords with another person. But sparring with Mito is just as fun as it is scary. It reminds me of when we used to play fighting games together on the school roof. Mito and I have changed a lot since then. Even then, I believe that some things never change.
