Beware the Strange Night Road Scout - Eydis Pick-Up

characters.name: [Master of Darkness] Eydis
characters.title: Master of Darkness
characters.desc: Nothing has changed much in the 200 years since I became an Integrity Knight. Still, it was fun in its own way. But that changed when I met Alice. Alice came into my life, followed by Kirito and the others, and then Alice and I parted ways... However, I believe things will continue to change in the future. Until the day we meet again, I have to keep enjoying my life.

characters.name: [A Hero Rises] Kirito
characters.title: A Hero Rises
characters.desc: Kirito distances himself from the popular MMORPG (Ordinal Scale) which uses the AR device (Augma). However, realizing that the cause for the abnormalities happening in Asuna's body was caused by Ordinal Scale, Kirito picks up the sword again in the world of Ordinal Scale in order to find the truth behind the targeting of SAO survivors.

characters.name: [A New Phase] Kirito
characters.title: A New Phase
characters.desc: Kirito carried Alice, who believed in him even after losing her eye from breaking the seal, on his back as he scaled the outer walls of the Cathedral. However, waiting for them in the Morning Star Lookout on the 95th floor was the Integrity Knight Eydis. Though the rebel Kirito warranted more than enough of a reason for Eydis to fight, it was inevitable when she saw the wounded Alice, whom Eydis loved like a sister.

characters.name: [The Star From My Dreams] Eugeo
characters.title: The Star From My Dreams
characters.desc: This is the costume that won the SAO Alicization Rising Steel Original Costume Design Contest held in June, 2020. It's an Astrologer's costume with a motif based on the Altair constellation.

characters.name: [Hold Up!] Kibaou
characters.title: Hold Up!
characters.desc: Finally! After having started a month ago, we've finally reached the boss. If we can clear the first floor, then there's hope yet that we can escape from this death game. But before we get to that, there's still one thing I need to take care of before dealing with the boss. Those who abandoned us when we were just newbies, the ones who monopolize the best hunting grounds and the best quests, those damn beta testers.

characters.name: [A Knight’s Resolve] Alice
characters.title: A Knight’s Resolve
characters.desc: Alice Synthesis Thirty, the 30th Integrity Knight of the Axiom Church in Underworld. After the Administrator’s death, she became a criminal for violating the Taboo Index, she stayed with Kirito, who had lost his soul, in a hut near Rulid Village . When the forces of the Dark Territory invaded, it was her duty as an Integrity Knight to pick up her sword again to protect the Human Empire.

characters.name: [Daybreak in the Land of the Fairies] Leafa
characters.title: Daybreak in the Land of the Fairies
characters.desc: Long ago, there lived a girl who devoted her whole life to kendo. Due to circumstances, she descended into the world of MMORPG which she despised, and gained invaluable experiences and friends. Trading in her sword for the brush at the start of the year, she wears a polished traditional Japanese outfit. Leafa's wish is to paint the skies of the Land of the Fairies during daybreak and paint a new beginning. Happiness has come!

characters.name: [Gorgeous Tea Party] Sortiliena
characters.title: Gorgeous Tea Party
characters.desc: At the Winter Solstice Festival, Kirito gave Sortiliena the origin of the festival - the nut of a special tree. Will Kirito find delicious tea for Sortiliena, just as he promised on that day?  As Sortiliena bakes a walnut pie for Kirito, her cheeks lay back to the thought of him running about looking for tea.

characters.name: [Girls Only Time] Leafa
characters.title: Girls Only Time
characters.desc: Tonight's the long awaited pajama party. Wearing the cute outfit that she's prepared for the occasion, Leafa finished decorating the walls of the room and gently laid down on the large bed, lost in her thoughts. "I wonder what we should talk about today?" Any conversations involving only girls are bound to be something truly special.

characters.name: [Dear You,] Sachi
characters.title: Dear You,
characters.desc: A SAO player. Member of the Moonlit Black Cats guild. Although she originally used a long spear in battle, due to the addition of Kirito she switched to wielding a sword and became a defensive role on the frontlines. Having bonded over their experiences in SAO, she became close with Kirito. She left behind a message that encouraged and cheered up the desperate Kirito.

characters.name: [Another Path] Alice
characters.title: Another Path
characters.desc: An undyed skirt in a blue hue reminiscent of autumn skies—that is the sort of thing that Alice Zuberg would have worn if she had grown up peacefully in Rulid Village. However, that future was not to be, as she was bound to become an Integrity Knight. "I cursed my fate, but Kirito taught me what I could and should do. I won't hesitate anymore. I swear to return to the world I love".

characters.name: [Refined Swordsmanship] Sortiliena
characters.title: Refined Swordsmanship
characters.desc: Sortiliena prepares to join the frontlines. Ever since she was a child, Sortiliena honed her sword skills for this one moment. But what her training never prepared her for was what it meant to put one's life on the line. Conflicted on whether she is ready for the fight ahead, she focuses on her training to calm her nerves...

characters.name: [Panic! At the Pool] Suguha
characters.title: Panic! At the Pool
characters.desc: Let's get swimming lessons! they said as Leafa went to the nearby pool. Although she wants to be able to swim, just the thought of going into the water is enough to make Leafa freeze up in her tracks. Clutching onto her brother, she holds onto him not out of embarrassment—but to keep herself from drowning.

characters.name: [Aim for the Sky] Leafa
characters.title: Aim for the Sky
characters.desc: Leafa in an outfit to celebrate our 2-year anniversary. Thank you for always being there! Whether good or bad times, we'll always have each other!

characters.name: [Beacon of Trust] Klein
characters.title: Beacon of Trust
characters.desc: Klein shivered as cold air wrapped around his body. Completing quests is important, but for Klein, working together with everyone was more fun than anything else. But his meeting with this female NPC changed everything...his soulmate. Klein felt that saving her was his calling. Trusting his feelings, Klein gripped his sword.

characters.name: [The Will to Fight] Medina
characters.title: The Will to Fight
characters.desc: Noble daughter of the 9th head of the Orthinanos family, second class noble family. Originally a calm and mild tempered girl,  when it comes to battle she quickly changes into another person. To win back the honor of the Orthinanos family name, she lives to get stronger and distinguish herself in the field of battle.

characters.name: [Let's Enjoy the Game] Anna Mochizuki
characters.title: Let's Enjoy the Game
characters.desc: I finally get it. This is the world where I'm always at. The characters and enemies are so real...not to mention the play style is completely different. But it's just the same as being inside a really fun game! The only difference being is that my friends are nearby...like on a different level!

characters.name: [Sparkling Sunshine Girl] Yuuki
characters.title: Sparkling Sunshine Girl
characters.desc: Nothing beats the sea! Or... Maybe I feel this way because... You're here? Hey, I have an idea! How about doing some volleyball next time? We came all the way here after all, so let's go all out!

characters.name: [Magical Stream] Kirito
characters.title: Magical Stream
characters.desc: 2.5-Year Anniversary Design! - Original concept by Yoshitsugu Matsuoka "Kirito the Witch" -

characters.name: [The World Where I Fought for My Life] Kirito
characters.title: The World Where I Fought for My Life
characters.desc: Once upon a time, there was a world where I fought for my life with a sword in hand. A world in a game, but not to be enjoyed. Above all, it's the world where she saved my life. She's been by my side ever since. A lot has happened since then, but that's the one thing that I'm sure won't change. No matter how difficult the path ahead may be, we can overcome anything as long as we're together.

characters.name: [Sparkling Spirit] Asuna
characters.title: Sparkling Spirit
characters.desc: Standing in the battlefield, Asuna observes the critical situation she finds herself in. Despite the countless number of enemies she's taken down, the enemy army continues to advance. But despite the odds, she will continue to protect this world instead of Kirito. With an unbreakable will, Alice continues her assault against the enemy.

characters.name: [Helping Hand] Sheyta
characters.title: Helping Hand
characters.desc: Turning around, her gaze fell upon a bright light. Acknowledging what was there, she slightly nodded and returned back to her original sight. There was no end in sight to the fighting, but something was brewing deep inside of her heart. Perhaps it was because she finally had someone who she could trust besides her? Reminiscing on these feelings, she grips on to her Black Lily Sword tightly.

characters.name: [Hidden Resolve] Mito
characters.title: Hidden Resolve
characters.desc: To think I'd end up dueling with Asuna in SAO. I'm no longer an Assault Team member, so I don't have enough strength to fight on the front lines. Still, it's strange. For some reason, crossing swords with her seems to be erasing all the regrets and worries that have occupied my mine for so long. It must be thanks to her...Asuna.

characters.name: [Sparkling Claw] Argo
characters.title: Sparkling Claw
characters.desc: A girl who was an informant in the VRMMORPG turned death game, SAO. The type of info she possesses is vast - ranging from anywhere from food to boss strategies. "For an informant, it's a disgrace to get only info from listening." Though she had her worries for the rash Kirito, she doesn't mind doing even boss reconnaissance by herself as long as she can get hidden info. Armed with her adept martial arts skills and quickness, she gathers up info on boss strategies to create a SAO strategy guide.

characters.name: [Beauty of the Harvest Festival] Tiese
characters.title: Beauty of the Harvest Festival
characters.desc: It's the night of the Harvest Festival. Putting on an outfit that she had prepared specifically for this day, Tiese leaves her dorm room and heads towards the stairs leading to the entrance. As she begins to descend down the stairs, she gets surprised as the students at the bottom of the stairs begin to direct their attention towards her. "Something must be off...I'll guess I'll have Ronie take a look later" Tiese thinks to herself as she nervously exited the dorms at a brisk pace. Soon after, rumors begin to circulate as to the identity of this mysterious beauty.

characters.name: [Wind Gust] Operator
characters.title: Wind Gust
characters.desc: Does the sky end? How far does it go on for? Staring back from the tiny window of the Cathedral, she stared up towards the sky and pondered these very questions. "What would it feel like to fly through the sky in this floating platform?" To fly with no limits, endlessly...

characters.name: [Shall We Dance?] Tiese
characters.title: Shall We Dance?
characters.desc: Shall we dance? my question was met with eyes that peered back at as if my words had lost their way to their rightful owner. "Time to have a little fun then!", I thought. I grabbed his hand before he could utter a response and lead him to the middle of the room. He was still shocked. Which, I found hilarious, so I laughed. And with a giggle, he finally figured out who he was dancing with. And so I smiled a little more, and I held on even tighter.

characters.name: [Idealistic Swordsman] Yui
characters.title: Idealistic Swordsman
characters.desc: All my life, I've dreamed of fighting alongside Mommy and Daddy. That day has finally come. No longer can I sit back and watch from the sides. With this sword, I will protect you! Mommy, Daddy! Here I come!

characters.name: [Young Serlut Style] Sortiliena
characters.title: Young Serlut Style
characters.desc: Sortiliena Serlut during her childhood years in Underworld. Within the Norlangarth Empire which recognizes High-Norkian Style as the official sword technique, she's part of a minority who adopted the Serlut Style. Because of that, she was treated as a heretic by those around her. It wasn't until she encountered the Zephyria flower that her life took a major change.

characters.name: [Childhood Memories] Alice
characters.title: Childhood Memories
characters.desc: A resident of Rulid Village in Underworld. The daughter of the village elder and childhood friend of Kirito and Eugeo. 8 years ago, when she went to the End Mountains to collect ice, she violated the Taboo Index by entering the Dark Territory to help a fallen Dark Knight. Arrested by the Integrity Knight Deusolbert, she was taken to the Cathedral.

characters.name: [Being Me] Selka
characters.title: Being Me
characters.desc: In the northernmost village of Rulid in Underworld lives an apprentice nurse. Living in the shadows of her gifted older sister Alice, she gets saved thanks to Kirito's kind words. With his sights set on Central City, Kirito requests to hear about the Creation Myth of this world.

characters.name: [Morning Dew Little Girl] Yui
characters.title: Morning Dew Little Girl
characters.desc: Wandering the forests with no memories, Yui was saved by Kirito and Asuns, whereupon the three began living like a family. However, while looking for her real parents in the Town of Beginnings, she got caught up in trouble and ran into the Blackiron Palace dungeon. It was there that the dangerous boss, The Fatal Scythe, lay waiting. Cornered, the girl with no memories slowly crept forward towards the enemy.

characters.name: [Little Adventurer] Eugeo
characters.title: Little Adventurer
characters.desc: Carver of the Gigas Cedar, Eugeo of Rulid Village. One day, to send off a sick Alice, Eugeo and his close friend Kirito headed into the forest to get apples. Clinging onto the trunk of the tree, Eugeo was afraid at first, but his fears quickly evaporated with the voice of Kirito calling out to him at the bottom of the tree. Before he knew it, Eugeo had climbed up to a pretty high position. Looking over at the delicious looking red fruit in front of him, a smile forms on Eugeo's face.

characters.name: [Continuing My Journey with You] Tiese
characters.title: Continuing My Journey with You
characters.desc: While on the way home from her excursions in the forests of the Swordcraft Academy, Novice trainee Tiese remembered the person who had a curiosity in golden flying foxes, Eugeo. "I said they weren't rare, but... speaking of which, I remember when I was a kid that me and my father found a golden flying fox in the hills..." Struck by the sudden recollection, Tiese's face beamed with joy as Ronie, who is walking besides her, looks at her suspiciously.

characters.name: [Noon at the Lake] Silica
characters.title: Noon at the Lake
characters.desc: How about we go on a small walk and eat outside? Silica suggested as she and the others exited the log house to go to a picnic at a nearby lake. Carrying along a large rucksack on her small frame, Silica walked all the way to the meadows where the flowers bloomed, and sat down. "I'm not the best cook...but if you don't mind, please try this!" Pulling out a hamper from her rucksack, nestled inside were neatly packed sandwiches.

characters.name: [Sincerity] Silica
characters.title: Sincerity
characters.desc: Silica intended to lock away her feelings deep within herself. Pouring all of what should couldn't express in words into her cake and wrapped it up with a special ribbon. She wanted everyone who she loved to try it, that part wasn't a lie. But, there was still only one person who she truly cared about... "It's ok to express how you feel at least once a year."

characters.name: [Petite Cupid] Yui
characters.title: Petite Cupid
characters.desc: Today is Mommy and Daddy's wedding anniversary. So that's why it's just the three of us here today. It was originally just going to be Mommy and Daddy celebrating, but in the end they wanted me to tag along... Daddy is nice and all, but sometimes I think it's alright to be a little pushy and bring Mommy along.

characters.name: [The Moon, Drink, and You] Bercouli
characters.title: The Moon, Drink, and You
characters.desc: Knight Commander Bercouli Synthesis One. After the death of the Administrator, the Human Empire began mobilizing it's forces against the invasion from the Dark Territory. Nestled beneath his busy days as a defender of the Human Empire lies a dimly faint light. The bright moon shines across the lands, for all eternity and with confidence. Their talks brings each other's heart gently closer.

characters.name: [Time to Celebrate the New Year] Lisbeth
characters.title: Time to Celebrate the New Year
characters.desc: Since it's the Year of the Tiger, I decided to wear this tiger-striped outerwear...and it's surprisingly warm! With this, I should be able to collect material in the snow mountains with ease. Plus, I'm staking out my honor as a master smith to win that new year's kite-flying match! There's no way I can lose!

characters.name: [Dreamy Cat Fairy] Sinon
characters.title: Dreamy Cat Fairy
characters.desc: Is the Holy Sword pronounced Excalibur? Or Exalibur? Sinon wondered. The thought made her reminiscence times with Kirito and the excitement that would come from his many late night stories. Pulling one of those same stories from the bookshelf and laying on her bed, she begins to fall asleep as she fondly remembers her time in ALO.
